items.title_en: Uber CEO says he expects employees to respond to emails on weekends: ‘Don’t come here if you want to coast’
items.title_zh: Uber首席执行官表示，他希望员工在周末回复电子邮件：“如果你想溜达，就不要来这里”
items.summary_en: In an interview, CEO Dara Khosrowshahi described Uber’s workplace culture as demanding and said employees are expected to take their responsibilities seriously.
items.summary_zh: 在接受采访时，首席执行官达拉·科斯罗萨西 (Dara Khosrowshahi) 形容 Uber 的工作场所文化要求很高，并表示员工应该认真对待自己的责任。

items.title_en: ‘They call us 7-Eleven’: Indian man on racist attack during Las Vegas trip

items.summary_en: Paramvir Singh Beniwal documented the encounter on YouTube during his Las Vegas trip.
items.summary_zh: 帕拉姆维尔·辛格·贝尼瓦尔 (Paramvir Singh Beniwal) 在拉斯维加斯之旅期间在 YouTube 上记录了这次遭遇。

items.title_en: ‘Where will they go?’ Bengaluru elephant attack sparks concerns over habitat loss
items.title_zh: “它们会去哪里？”班加罗尔大象袭击引发对栖息地丧失的担忧
items.summary_en: Forest officials said this was the first time an elephant had come into conflict with humans so close to the city.
items.summary_zh: 森林官员表示，这是大象第一次在如此靠近城市的地方与人类发生冲突。

items.title_zh: 为什么中国贸易商认为印度客户“很难”合作
items.summary_en: Chinese electronics trader Jay Chen’s comments about Indian clients, price negotiations and scams have sparked a debate on social media.

items.title_en: 8 sons, 5 daughters: Why this Chinese couple raised 13 children despite financial struggles
items.title_zh: 8个儿子，5个女儿：为什么这对中国夫妇在经济困难的情况下抚养了13个孩子
items.summary_en: The couple, identified as Huang, 49, and his wife, 42, live in a village in Qinzhou, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

items.title_en: How A $25,000 Beach Cottage Became One Of The Most Iconic Homes In American History
items.title_zh: 价值 25,000 美元的海滩小屋如何成为美国历史上最具标志性的住宅之一
items.summary_en: The Kennedy Compound is almost as famous as the Kennedy family itself. Located in Hyannis Port, Massachusetts, the property — which is made up of three houses set along the beaches of Cape Cod — has been the site of many important moments in the history of the political dynasty. Click here to view slideshow It was there, in 1953, that John F. Kennedy brought Jackie after proposing marriage.
items.summary_zh: 肯尼迪大院几乎与肯尼迪家族本身一样出名。该地产位于马萨诸塞州海恩尼斯港，由科德角海滩沿岸的三栋房屋组成，是这个政治王朝历史上许多重要时刻的所在地。单击此处查看幻灯片 1953 年，约翰·F·肯尼迪 (John F. Kennedy) 正是在那里向杰姬求婚。

items.title_en: Archaeologists In Greece Found An Ancient School Complete With Intact Benches Where Students Like Alexander The Great Listened To Lectures More Than 2,000 Years Ago
items.title_zh: 希腊考古学家发现了一所古老的学校，里面有完整的长凳，2000多年前亚历山大大帝等学生曾在这里听课
items.summary_en: Hellenic Ministry of Culture Archaeologists in northern Greece discovered the school where it’s likely that Aristotle taught Alexander the Great and other Macedonian royals. Archaeologists excavating near Naousa in northern Greece recently uncovered a roughly 2,400-year-old school complex, or gymnasium. The site, which stood in the ancient Macedonian town of Mieza, may have been where Aristotle taught in the 4th century B.C.E. items.title_en: How this 78-year-old gamer became the oldest woman Fortnite streamer
items.title_zh: 这位 78 岁的玩家如何成为最年长的《堡垒之夜》女性主播
items.summary_en: Cath Bowie, 78, has become the oldest woman Fortnite streamer on Twitch, attracting more than 24,000 followers.
items.summary_zh: 78 岁的 Cath Bowie 成为 Twitch 上最年长的《堡垒之夜》女性主播，吸引了超过 24,000 名粉丝。
